title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
Python Developer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.
Description
Every Toradex Linux image is booted and tested several hundred times on real hardware before it ships. You'll own the software system that makes that possible: a hardware-in-the-loop CI/CD pipeline that builds Yocto/Torizon images and validates them on a physical board farm of Toradex SoMs.
The existing setup is a full stack from Jenkins and BuildBot builds to the hardware sitting in shelfs via custom-designed controllers and LAVA. You will work in the team that owns the Software Infrastructure driving the builds and hardware testing. You’ll expand our build system and help Toradex grow its on-prem build farm.
This role spans the whole path: server deployment, pipeline orchestration, job dispatch, device control, systems administration and the reporting that engineers actually trust to gate a release.
About You
You're an engineer who designs and evolves CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling as first-class software.
You write clean, maintainable Python and treat build and deployment infrastructure with the same rigor as production code.
You understand the whole pipeline and can make failures observable, so a boot failure on a real device produces an actionable report instead of a mystery.
You understand business trade-offs and how they live with the release process the infrastructure gates.
You care about reproducibility, fast feedback loops, and keeping build and test cycles short.
You deeply understand Linux or Embedded Linux and keep up-to-date with the latest developments in the OS community.
Skills
Required:
Strong Python for automation tooling: CLIs, job templating, pipeline logic, device control, reporting. Experience in other languages and an appetite to learn is welcomed.
Solid CI/CD expertise (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Actions), including pipeline design, shared libraries, and gating strategy.
Docker and container-based deployment, plus experience keeping build and runtime environments reproducible.
Experience keeping automation infrastructure reproducible and maintainable, with a focus on known-good state and version control.
Excellent Git skills.
Linux systems administration (services, udev, networking).
Comfort reasoning about embedded Linux boot flows at a functional level (serial consoles, TFTP/NFS boot, U-Boot) even if you don't work at the hardware layer day to day.
Excellent communication skills in English (additional languages are an advantage)
Available to work Hybrid from Toradex Office in Campinas/SP.
Nice to Have
Comfort close to hardware: flashing, recovery, and working with power/reset/recovery lines on a backplane.
LAVA or another hardware-in-the-loop / board-farm framework (labgrid etc.).
Yocto / OpenEmbedded / bitbake build systems.
Ansible and infrastructure automation; build-farm scaling (sstate caches, ephemeral cloud workers).
Experience with Server Management Infrastructure and observability stacks such as Grafana, Cockpit, Zabbix etc.
What We Offer
An agile and inter-cultural work environment
Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
Participation in defining processes and your working environment
Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
Opportunities for your personal development
Meal allowance (flash card)
Health and dental care
Flexible working hours
Parking space
Anniversary day off
Disclaimer: This is not a temporary role. It is a long-term, full-time opportunity.
Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.
We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.
For more information
Visit our Homepage: www.toradex.com
Connect with us and join our community!: https://community.toradex.com

title: Software Engineer (Go, Python, CI/CD platform) Rotation On-Call , Hybrid
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
Join FactSet's Release Infrastructure team and own the developer platforms that power engineering teams worldwide. You'll manage critical platforms —GitHub, Sourcegraph, SonarQube, and Artifactory —that directly impacts how quickly we deliver financial data and analytics solutions to investment professionals globally.
Responsibilities
Build and maintain backend services in Go and Python
Develop automation that scales across thousands of engineers
Design and deploy cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Linux
Architect integrations between enterprise platforms
Evaluate emerging tools and drive adoption of modern engineering practices
Participate in an on-call rotation to support critical infrastructure (7 days for 12 hours - 2 weeks off and then back on call for 7 days/12hours)
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of 2 years' experience in writing backend services and/or automation using a high-level programming language (Strong preference for Go, Python, or NodeJS). Willingness to learn and develop in multiple languages used by team (Go and Python).
Minimum of 2 years' experience developing software release pipelines for publishing libraries/applications/services using CI/CD platform(s) (Strong preference for GitHub/GitLab/ Forgejo Actions).
Critical /Required Skills
Familiarly with Continuous Integration and Delivery best practices.
Experience in system administrative tasks, including deployment, configuration, and operation of Linux systems (Strong preference for Debian-based distributions).
Ability to clearly communicate with geographically distributed team members, and other employees, using asynchronous communication tools.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science
Desired Skills
Familiarity with the following platforms: GitHub and Artifactory.
Experience using an Infrastructure as Code tool, such as Terraform/OpenTofu or Pulumi, for architecting, deploying, and managing cloud infrastructure.
Experience using Docker and Kubernetes.
Company Overview
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.
